sessions.title: IBM Atlas: System intelligence that discovers everything so you can understand anything
sessions.description: See IBM Atlas in action as it discovers and maps relationships across your IT environment, from hardware and operating systems to middleware, software, and business applications. Through a live demonstration, attendees will explore Atlas’s dynamic topology visualization and AI-powered chat experience, enabling users to quickly understand dependencies, answer environment questions, and gain actionable insights. Learn how organizations are leveraging Atlas for change management, audit readiness, application refactoring, business service mapping, and drift detection, while also helping shape the future of the platform through direct feedback.
sessions.roomSetup: Each station needs monitor, monitor stand, high-top table, chair and easel – to be set up before 3:30pm
sessions.specialReqs: Will need large sticky pad for easel

sessions.title: Would You Trust an AI Agent With This?
sessions.description: Experience Agentic AI in action within IBM Concert for Z and see how AI can accelerate problem determination by analyzing system signals, identifying likely causes, gathering evidence, and recommending next steps. After the live demonstration, participate in a quick interactive voting exercise where you'll decide whether specific operational tasks should be automated by AI, assisted by AI, or remain under human control. This engaging session explores the evolving relationship between human expertise and AI-driven operations, highlighting how Agentic AI can help address knowledge gaps,reduce reliance on specialized experts, and improve decision-making across complex environments. Attendees will gain insight into the practical applications of autonomous operations while helping shape the future direction of Concert for Z's Agentic AI capabilities.
sessions.roomSetup: Each station needs monitor, monitor stand, high-top table, chair and easel – to be set up before 3:30pm
sessions.specialReqs: Will need large sticky pad for easel

sessions.title: Project Brain Bank: Turning IBM Z knowledge into trusted AI-ready guidance
sessions.description: Discover Project Brain Bank, an early concept for transforming scattered IBM Z knowledge—from documentation and support insights to product expertise and operational learnings—into structured, AI-generated guidance backed by trusted sources. Attendees will see a simple before-and-after demonstration showing how information can be consolidated into actionable answers with supporting evidence, recommended next steps, and source transparency. Visitors will be invited to evaluate an AI-generated response and share what would make it trustworthy enough for real-world use. Through a quick interactive activity, participants will help shape the future of AI-assisted IBM Z guidance by identifying the trust signals, evidence, and transparency mechanisms needed to confidently leverage AI in enterprise environments.
sessions.roomSetup: Each station needs monitor, monitor stand, high-top table, chair and easel – to be set up before 3:30pm
sessions.specialReqs: Will need large sticky pad for easel

sessions.title: Software Management-as-Code - IBM Z Install
sessions.description: Experience a hands-on demonstration of IBM Z Install and see how software management can be transformed through a GitOps-driven, software management-as-code approach. Attendees will explore a prototype that uses standard repositories to configure, deploy, and track z/OS software across partitions, providing a centralized inventory of what is installed, where it is running, and how it was deployed. The session showcases a self-service, AI-assisted experience that brings together software installation, governance, and auditability using industry-standard workflows. Learn how IBM is extending Infrastructure-as-Code, Configuration-as-Code, and Policy-as-Code principles to z/OS software management, helping organizations improve visibility, streamline operations, and accelerate time to value while maintaining business controls and compliance.
sessions.roomSetup: Each station needs monitor, monitor stand, high-top table, chair and easel – to be set up before 3:30pm
sessions.specialReqs: Will need large sticky pad for easel

sessions.title: IBM Project Polaris Tech Preview 2.0 and Beyond
sessions.description: Explore how IBM Project Polaris is extending As-Code practices across z/OS, moving beyond isolated configuration tasks to support Networking, Storage Management, Workload Manager (WLM), and other core system domains. Through a hands-on demonstration, attendees will see how configurations and policies can be defined, validated, and managed using modern workflows, with guidance from intelligent automation and agentic AI. The session highlights how Polaris helps both new and experienced system programmers adopt industry-standard As-Code approaches to improve consistency, governance, reviewability, and confidence when managing change. Visitors will have the opportunity to interact with the experience, provide feedback, and help shape the future of As-Code management for enterprise z/OS environments.
sessions.roomSetup: Each station needs monitor, monitor stand, high-top table, chair and easel – to be set up before 3:30pm

sessions.title: Workload Expansion: The Future of IBM Z
sessions.description: As organizations seek to modernize and consolidate more workloads within their existing data center footprint, the IBM Z ecosystem is evolving to support new architectures, deployment models, and development patterns. This interactive exhibit explores IBM’s vision for a more secure, scalable, and versatile platform, highlighting how emerging technologies—including architectures such as ARM—can complement traditional workloads and create new opportunities for innovation on IBM Z. Attendees will participate in collaborative activities designed to uncover new use cases, identify adoption opportunities, and explore where hybrid architectures could deliver the greatest business value. Participants will help shape the direction of an expanded IBM Z ecosystem that brings together mission-critical reliability with modern application and infrastructure experiences.

sessions.title: From Client Configuration Data to Simplification Signals
sessions.description: The IBM Z Configuration Collection Program demonstrates how real-world client configuration data can be used to identify opportunities for simplification across the platform. This exhibit showcases how IBM has analyzed customer configuration data and identified a subset of configuration settings as candidates for simplification, helping teams better understand where complexity exists and where focused improvements may provide the greatest value. Attendees will see how these insights are already being used to inform IBM Z simplification efforts and explore how configuration intelligence could influence future capabilities such as Project Polaris and the z/OS configuration registry. Visitors will also have the opportunity to discuss their own configuration challenges and help shape future priorities for reducing friction, improving usability, and simplifying system management.
